{{Quote|What ridiculous fighters you are! You're all so over-armored. This is like knocking over servo-droids!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 89">[[Star Wars (1977) 89|''Star Wars'' (1977) 89]]</ref>}}
The '''Solay Royal Guard''' were the armed forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Solay]], who supported the despotic [[Solay Royal Court]] led by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Blackart]]. The guards were heavily armored including a distinct helmet that covered the majority of the head. The guards were equipped with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons, but their heavy armor made using the weapons difficult. During the overthrow of the royal court in the [[Battle of Solay]], the royal guard proved ineffective in preventing the rebels led by [[Raggold]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] from capturing the King.

[[File:SolayGuard.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Luke Skywalker knocking the guard aside during the Battle of Solay]]

During the battle, Skywalker found the attacks of the guard to be incredibly feeble, and he was easily able to knock the soldiers off of their feet. Their heavy armor put them off balance, allowing the rebels to easily outmaneuver them.
